messages:
maya: Quick design check — trying to compact run-history cards without losing schema visibility. Thoughts?

alex: I like collapsing non-essential metadata. Maybe hide token counts behind a chevron. :+1:

juan: If we collapse, we need a clear affordance to expand KV pairs for tool calls. Current mock hides args too aggressively — users will miss important fields.

sam: From perf side, collapsing is fine. Concern: users will need to copy structured outputs. Let's keep a 'Copy JSON' button visible in the compact row.

olivia: A11y: don't rely on hover. Expand must be keyboard focusable and announce role=button with aria-expanded. Also some of the badge colors are <contrast> low.

maya: Agree — proposal: default compact view shows who, when, and a one-line parsed output; expand reveals full JSON + tool call stack. Wording debate: 'Show structured result' vs just 'Expand'?

alex: Prefer 'Show structured result' — clearer for non-dev folks. Short label though; maybe icon + short text.

juan: Mock idea:
```html
<button aria-expanded="false" class="compact-toggle">Show structured result</button>
```
Also suggest truncating long arrays with '…' and a 'View full result' CTA.

sam: Edge case: function outputs with code blocks — render monospaced even in compact. Could use mini-scroll for long code snippets to avoid huge card heights.

olivia: :memo: Microcopy nits: instead of 'View all' use 'View full result' for clarity. Avoid single-word labels like 'Expand' alone.

maya: Can someone update the Playground mock and I'll run a quick accessibility pass? @sam can you check render perf for nested JSON expands?

sam: Yep, I'll benchmark with 50 concurrent expands. Also can we lazy-render the JSON tree to avoid layout thrash?

alex: Also telemetry: add an event when users expand structured view so we can measure utility. Make sure enterprise customers can opt out/disable.

maya: Good call. Keep it anonymized counts only. @ci-bot can we get a ticket for telemetry + opt-out spec?

ci-bot: Created issue INF-4873: 'Playground: structured result expand telemetry' — assigned to alex, link: https://redwood/INF-4873

juan: One more idea: keyboard shortcut to toggle structured view when focused on a run item? Maybe 's' or '/'?

olivia: Be careful with global shortcuts — conflict with textareas. If we do it, scope to the focused run item and ensure we document it in the keyboard shortcut help.

maya: Action items:
- Juan: update mock with 'Show structured result' button + truncation pattern.
- Alex: draft telemetry spec + opt-out.
- Sam: perf + lazy-render implementation plan.
- Olivia: a11y checklist (aria-expanded, keyboard focus, contrast).
- Maya: iterate copy and run a quick review.

alex: :thumbsup: timeline?

maya: EOD Friday for first pass. Ping me in this thread when done.

juan: On it, starting mock now.

sam: I'll post perf numbers here when ready.

olivia: I'll paste the a11y checklist here (keyboard, screenreader verbs, focus states).

ci-bot: Reminder: Standup at 10:00 — don't forget to mention this thread. :bell:
